translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Asaa Nashechchanaw Bessiyaa Ogiyaa
Nuuni ammanuwaan minneeddawanttu daaburanchchatuwaa tookuwaa tookkanaw bessee; nuuni nu s'alalaa nashechchanaw bessena.
Nuuni huup'iyaan huup'iyaan nu ishaa maaddanaw, ammanuwaan Aa minisanawunne nashechchanaw bessee.
Ayaw gooppe, haray atto Kiristtoosikka barena nashechchibeenna. Shin S'oossaa Mas'aafay, «Neena boreeddawanttu boreedda borii ta bolla wod'd'eedda» geeddawaadan haneedda.
S'oossaa Mas'aafay nuw immiyaa genc'c'aaninne minotaan nuuni demmana giide nashechchaan naagi utteeddawe de'ana mala, S'oossaa Mas'aafan s'aafetteedda ubbabay nuuna tamaarissanaw s'aafetteedda.

Hinttenttu ubbay itti wozana gidiide, itti k'aalaan S'oossaa, nu Godaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosa Aawuwaa, bonchchana mala, genc'c'uwaanne minotetsaa immiyaa S'oossay, hinttenttoo Kiristtoosi Yesuusi ootseeddawaadan, ittuu ittuwaanna ittippe de'iyaa itti k'ofaa immo.
P'awuloosa Oosuwaanne Ammanenna AsawGakkeedda Mishiraachchuwaa K'aalaa
Hewaa diraw, Kiristtoosi hinttentta mokkeeddawaadan, S'oossaa bonchchoo ittuu ittuwaa mokkite.

Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay ammanetteedawaa gidiyaawaa erissanaw, S'oossay aawaatoo immana geeddawaa tumayanawunne Ayihuda gidenna Asay S'oossaa Aa maarotetsaa diraw bonchchanaw Kiristtoosi Ayihudatoo k'ooma gideeddawaa hinttenttoo oday. Hewaa S'oossaa Mas'aafay,
yaagee.
yaagee.

content.text: Godaa galatite; asaw ubbaw, Aa galatite»

content: yaagee.

content.text: K'ay unttunttu Aa baggana demmana giide,

content: yaagee.

Hinttenttu akkana giide nashechchaan naagiyaawe Geeshsha Ayaanaa wolk'k'aan dic'c'anaadan, hinttenttoo immana geedda S'oossay, hintte Aa ammaniyaa diraw, hinttenttoo nashechchaanne sarotetsaa kuntsiide immo.
P'awuloosi S'aliide S'aafeedda Gaasuwaa
Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, hinttenttun lo"otetsaynne eratetsay ubbay kumeeddawaanne k'ay ittuu ittuwaa zoranaw danddayiyaawaa taani ta huup'ew eraad.

Shin taani hinttentta ittibaa ittibaa gujja k'ofissanaw, ha dabddaabbiyaa giddon ayinne yayyenaan hinttenttoo s'aafaad. Taani Kiristtoosa Yesuusa k'ooma gidaade, Ayihuda gidenna asaw ootsanaadan, S'oossay taw aad'd'o keekatetsaa immeedda diraw, taani ayinne yayabeykke; Ayihuda gidenna Asay Geeshsha Ayaanaa baggana S'oossaw geeshsha gidiide, Aa nashechchiyaa yarshshuwaa gidanaadan, S'oossaa wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa odiyaawaan geeshshatetsaan ootsay.
Hewaa diraw, taani Kiristtoosa Yesuusan gidaade S'oossaw ootsiyaaban c'eek'ettanaw danddayay.

Ayihuda gidenna Asay S'oossaw azazettanaadan, Kiristtoosi ta baggana k'aalaan, oosuwaan, mallaan, malaataa wolk'k'aaninne Geeshsha Ayaanaa wolk'k'aan ootseeddawaa s'alalaa taani odanaappe attin, harabaa odanaw s'alikke. Hewaa diraw, Yerusaalameppe doommaade, Iliwaarik'oona geetettiyaa gadiyaa gakkanaw yuuyyaade, Kiristtoosa wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa wurssa odaaddi.
Hawaadankka, taani hara Asay doommeeddawaa bollan doommennaadan, Kiristtoosa suntsay s'eesettibeennasan wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa odanaw amottaad.
Shin S'oossaa Mas'aafay,
yaagee.
P'awuloosi Roome Baanaw K'oppeedda
Hewaa diraw, taani c'ora wode hinttenttukko yaanaw koyyay; shin yaanaw danddayabeykke.
Shin taani ha"i ha heeraan ta oosuwaa wursseedda dirawunne c'ora laytsaappe doommaade hinttentta baade be'anaw laamoteedda diraw

ha"ikka hinttenttukko baana gaade k'oppay; taani Isippeene geetettiyaa gadiyaa baadde hinttentta be'anaw koyyay; k'ay amareeda wodiyaa hinttentta be'aade nashettowaappe guyyiyaan, Isippeene biishshin, hintte taana maaddana mala koyyay.
Shin ha"i taani S'oossaa asatuwaa maaddanaw, Yerusaalamebay.
Ayaw gooppe, Mak'idooniyaanne Akaayiyaa geetettiyaa gadiyaan de'iyaa woosa golle asatuu Yerusaalamen de'iyaa hiyyeesatoo miishshaa immanaw koyyeeddino.

Unttunttu barenttu huup'ew hawaa ootsanaw k'ofaa k'achcheeddino. Unttunttu he hiyyeesatuwaa maaddanawe unttunttoo ac'uu de'ee; ayaw gooppe, Ayihudatuu barenttu ayaanaa anjjuwaa Ayihuda gidenna asatuwaana shaakkeeddawaa gidooppe, Ayihuda gidenna asatuukka k'ay barenttoo de'eeddabaan Ayihudatuwaa maaddanaw bessee.
Hewaa diraw, taani ha oosuwaa wursseeddawaappe guyyiyaaninne unttunttoo shiik'eedda miishshaa ubbaa immeeddawaappe guyyiyaan, Isippeene baadde hintte mataanna aad'd'ana.
Taani hinttenttukko biyaa wode, Kiristtoosa anjjuu taanan kumina baanawaa eray.
Taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, taw S'oossaa hintte woossiidde, woosan hintte taananna minnanaadan, Godaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosa baggannanne Geeshsha Ayyaanay immiyaa siik'otetsan taani hinttentta woossay.
Taani Yihudaan de'iyaa ammanennawanttuppe attanaadaaninne k'ay taani Yerusaalamen ootsiyaa oosuu yaan de'iyaa S'oossaa asatuwaa nashechchiyaawaa gidanaadan, S'oossaa woossite.
K'ay S'oossay gooppe, taani hinttenttukko nashechchaan baade, hintte matan shemppana.
Sarotetsaa S'oossay hinttenttunna ubbaanna gido. Amen"i.
